subject: The King
body:
You're in Elythia! We're practically neighbors. The King lives here, at his royal tree, and he carries the Mind Stone. He won't hand it over. I've added a page about him to the book, with directions to the tree. @archive:antarchy:king

I'd come and meet you, but I'm in the middle of something. Please be careful.

Your old friend,
Dr. T
